summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Operoo Staff & Guest Management Platform - Phase 2 (Dashboard UI + Staff Management CRUD). All 18 test features passed successfully. Dashboard shows correct stats, quick actions, activity feed, and staff overview. Staff Management page has full CRUD functionality with search and filters working correctly. Language switcher (EN/IT) works on both pages. Responsive design works at mobile (375px) and tablet (768px) viewports. Logout redirects to login page.
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is excellent - proper use of data-testid attributes on all interactive elements
Staff CRUD is frontend-only with React state (mock data) - working as expected for Phase 1
i18n implementation is complete with proper translations for EN/IT
Responsive design properly implemented with mobile card layout and hidden sidebar on smaller viewports
seed_data_creation: Mock data in /app/frontend/src/data/mockData.js - 12 staff members, 6 activity items
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 frontend testing complete. All dashboard and staff management features working. Staff CRUD is frontend-only (mock data in React state). Next phase should add backend API integration for staff management.
